fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: If the active field is set to False, it will allow you to hide the orderpoint without removing it.

fields.name: product_min_qty
fields.label: Min Quantity
fields.help: When the virtual stock goes below the Min Quantity specified for this field, Odoo generates a procurement to bring the forecasted quantity above of this Min Quantity.

fields.name: product_max_qty
fields.label: Max Quantity
fields.help: When the virtual stock goes below the Min Quantity, Odoo generates a procurement to bring the forecasted quantity up to (or near to) the Max Quantity specified for this field (or to Min Quantity, whichever is bigger).

fields.name: qty_multiple
fields.label: Quantity Multiple
fields.help: The procurement quantity will be rounded up to a multiple of this field quantity. If it is 0, it is not rounded.

fields.name: visibility_days
fields.label: Visibility Days
fields.help:
Consider product forecast these many days in the future upon product replenishment, set to 0 for just-in-time.
The value depends on the type of the route (Buy or Manufacture)
